title: Word Frequency (HashMap)
hints: For each word: read its current count (0 if it's new), add 1, and store it back.
counts.put(word, counts.getOrDefault(word, 0) + 1) does all of that in one line.
new TreeMap<>() instead of new HashMap<>() keeps the words in alphabetical order.
